model_output:
```sql
WITH port_gibson_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Port Gibson' AND border_type = 'city'
),
flattest_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast,
        (SELECT geom FROM port_gibson_geom),
        TRUE
      ),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM port_gibson_geom)
    )
),
min_slope_value AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS min_slope
  FROM
    flattest_slope
)
SELECT
  min_slope AS flattest_slope_degrees
FROM
  min_slope_value;
```
